requirements.subtitle: The 190 has both federal visa rules and Victorian nomination-specific requirements. You need both sets aligned.

groups.title: Federal 190 visa requirements
items: Occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list
Positive skills assessment for your nominated occupation
At least 65 points including the 5 nomination points
Age under 45 at time of invitation

groups.title: Victorian nomination requirements
items: Valid EOI in SkillSelect selecting Victoria
Separate ROI lodged through Live in Melbourne
Skills assessment with at least 12 weeks validity remaining when nomination is lodged
Commitment to live and work in Victoria for at least 2 years
Evidence that your profile aligns with Victoria's selection priorities
